name: skills_tool_required_env_vars
notes: C port (skills_tool.c::skills_tool_required_env_vars) is a minimal strstr-based name extractor; LIVE adds _ENV_VAR_NAME_RE validation, prompt/help normalization, required_for/optional flags and dedupe. Gate pins the agreed subset (plain valid names, no duplicates, list-or-dict entry forms, missing key handled by caller contract); richer entries are a documented divergence.
